role: AUTHOR exploratory descriptive recount of existing measurements
interpretation: Requiring two distinct positive footprint sizes changes the prevalence of maximum ties; LIMIT1 is detected exactly by multiple maximum rows. Eligible cohort excludes142 tie-exposing packs with fewer than two distinct positive footprint sizes. It complements rather than replaces a tie-specific witness.

sqlExample.sql: WITH members AS (SELECT DISTINCT cr FROM cr_in_pack WHERE pack_id=?), typed AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.cr,s.spec,s.release,s.clause FROM cr_modifies_section m JOIN section s ON s.id=m.section_id), footprints AS (SELECT m.cr,COUNT(t.spec) AS n FROM members m LEFT JOIN typed t ON t.cr=m.cr GROUP BY m.cr) SELECT REPLACE(cr,'tdoc:',''),n FROM footprints WHERE n=(SELECT MAX(n) FROM footprints) ORDER BY cr
